subject: general
question:
A shopkeeper offers the following discount schemes for the purchase of his goods. Find the scheme which has the maximum discount.

(i) Two successive discounts of 20% and 10%

(ii) Discount of 10%

(iii) Buy 8 and get 4 free

(iv) Buy 9 and get 6 free
solution:
GIVEN:

4 schemes offered by shopkeeper

FORMULA USED:

S.P. = ( 1- d1/100) × ( 1- d2/100) × M.P. 

Where, S.P. = Selling price, M.P. = Marked price, and d1 and d2 = successive discounts respectively.

Discount =( M.P. - S.P.)

Discount% = ( Discount /M.P. )× 100

CALCULATION:

Let us assume the Marked price is Rs100.

On considering condition (a), we have

Here d1 = 20% , d2 = 10%

S.P. = ( 1- 20/100) × ( 1- 10/100) × 100 = 80/100 × 90/100 × 100 = Rs 72.

Discount = ( 100 - 72) = Rs 28

Discount% =( 28/100) × 100 = 28%

On considering condition (c), we have

 Buy 8 and get 4 free

Now, as we have assumed Marked price of 1 article = Rs100

Hence, M.P. of 12 articles = Rs 1200.

As the 4 articles are free,

Hence, S.P. of 8 articles = Rs 800 ⇔ Discount = (1200 - 800) = Rs400.

Discount% = (400/1200) × 100 = 33.33%.

On considering condition (d), we have 

Buy 9 get 6 free,

Now, M.P. of 15 articles = Rs1500.

As 6 articles are free, 

Hence, S.P. of 9 articles = Rs900. ⇔ Now, Discount = ( 1500 - 900) = Rs600.

Discount% = (600/1500) × 100 = 40%

Since condition (d) i.e. Buy 9 get 6 free has maximum discount % i.e. 40%.

**The answer is ****(iv)**
